description: Gosh!!!! I LOVE personally connecting with THE PEOPLE of this District and listening to their concerns! Grand Finale of our Town Hall Listening Sessions tonight with Rep. Steve Drazkowski.I will always be open and honest!And when I don’t know something I’ll research for you…. Transparency is important in a politician and I challenge you to see that I’m the only candidate willing to take the hard questions and be fully dedicated to serving this District!
title: Town Hall: Goodhue on 6/30
